column4: For every admissible n>=20 an SQS must simultaneously admit n/2 block-colorings at every derived point. A single resolvable STS or small n certificate does not construct the required all-order compatible quadruple systems; no full-scope construction found.
The relationship between m,n,e and F is unstated, as is H_1. A Walsh bound for a guessed Boolean component would not review the quantified vectorial problem. Restore definitions first.

The maximum-eigenvalue moment hypothesis and even the referenced theorem number are missing. Weak empirical spectral convergence alone permits outliers; that observation is not a counterexample to the omitted moment assumption.

The bound ranges over all directed multigraphs and all vertex functions f>=2. Coloring cycles away while simultaneously controlling two degree capacities needs a structural branching partition theorem; small constant-f examples do not supply it. Loop conventions need source confirmation before any counterexample.

The assertion is eventual in n for every a,r,d,s in the stated range. Finite optimization at fixed n cannot refute the sufficiently-large qualifier. No competing infinite family with a proved product advantage derived.

P-connected coloring is not defined; the quantifier is over all honest sequence properties, not one path-coloring rule. Concatenation and block closure alone do not determine which graph paths must be available.

Requires the exact Ramsey-Turan density limit convention and meaning of asymptotic extremality. Even a density formula does not by itself imply the asserted stability partition for every extremal sequence. No full-scope stability mechanism.

All degrees (a,b,c) and permitted l are quantified, but the Spin_3 structure, orientation and invariant convention refer to Theorem 2-W. A sign computed under another convention is not a counterexample; no invariant-body computation attempted.

Exact match to Conjecture 2.4 in arXiv2302.12106v1. Definition 4.1 reflected trees, Lemmas 4.2-4.3 and concluding proof give unbounded required width at treewidth 2. Local proof body read; this is already supplied by the source, not a new discovery.

The determinant quantifies over CM fields and primes; the displayed U_p^- uses unspecified absolute-value/linear-extension conventions. This is a structural p-adic regulator nonvanishing problem, not a small exact determinant over a fixed rational matrix.

For each k,l one needs one connectivity threshold valid for every graph, forbidden k-set and permitted edge. Complete graphs give only trivial instances; no general removable induced-cycle construction survives this quantifier scope.

Critical values, motivic normalization and period compatibility across all Dirichlet twists require source definitions. Corrupted newline-zero symbols are retained literally; no period construction or theorem subsumption established.

Uniform exponential WSM/SSM and uniqueness at the critical boundary are different assertions; the statement combines them. The q=Delta strictness does not settle other critical cases. Need actual boundary-rate definitions before exploiting equality as a purported refutation.

Literal prose reports that its own source proves the all-BMS capacity assertion. Success probability for individual bits versus entire codewords and the n/m_i rate notation need theorem-body confirmation. No credit or audited all-codeword retirement from this report alone.

Normal coloring and poor edges need their incidence definitions. The conditional NC(G) nonempty premise cannot be discarded to attack the Petersen Coloring Conjecture. Both positive and >=6 clauses must be distinguished.

Source Conjecture 5.4 really prints exact equality for all sufficiently large n to one Bessel process; Section 5 supplies only heuristics and Theorem 5.5 convergence in distribution. Fixed-process versus n-dependent coupling is a material scope issue. A scaling objection is a wording/coupling correction, not a qualifying new polymer theorem; no proof proposed.

Source Conjecture 5.6 and its heuristic were read. The quenched measure, W process, lattice centering and uniformity in k depend on model definitions. Failure of an exact coupling formulation does not refute this asymptotic local limit. No tail exclusion route established.

The packing and relaxation are specified by figures and approximate ratios; the neighborhood around r1 and exact disk radii are not given. A numerical comparison at rounded radii cannot settle either global optimality clause.

The all-section relative moduli-space assertion depends on categories constructed in Theorem 1.1 and their numerical K groups. Fiberwise stability is not a relative stability condition; no short degeneration-compatible construction is available.

The literal statement itself reports a public construction with roots O(log Delta/Delta) for each k>=3, asymptotically defeating Delta^(-1/(k-1)). This is an explicit source-resolution warning, not proof-body clearance: the construction and estimates were not fetched or audited here.

The factor C_Delta^{o(log n)} has no quantified error function in the record. The claimed embedding is for all color-family sizes t with per-color degree bounded, not bounded total degree. A usual one-color expansion theorem does not cover this scope.

QM series and all three U functions are only described as defined above. No coefficients or moduli conventions are supplied; equality of four arbitrary named series is not a complete mathematical statement review.

The record reports the public S3 versus proposed n=4 comparison 12>10 and infinite-order failure. NT is not defined and neither calculation nor source body was audited here. Recomputing this known parameter witness would give no credit.

Q_k and both ordered polynomial classes are not defined. Absence of a largest element in A_k does not imply absence of maximal elements, and gives no contradiction to largest-in-the-subclass. No order-theoretic shortcut is valid.

For general r points in P^n the claim is an all-degree generic Hilbert-function formula. Base field/general-point conventions are omitted. Testing one point configuration cannot verify generic rank in every n,r,e; no full-scope Koszul-only argument found.

For every chromatic threshold c one needs uniformly large dichromatic number to force an oriented pair of c-chromatic subtournaments. The equivalence reported with a graph conjecture is not a solution. No bounded certificate can establish this universal threshold statement.

The ambient valued-field theory and saturation are not stated. Generic stability, G00 and residue domination depend on that theory; replacing it by an arbitrary valued field is not an authorized scope correction or counterexample.

Simultaneous near-primality values of every irreducible polynomial with local approximation and archimedean growth includes deep prime-value behavior. Chinese remainder approximation alone does not control prime factorization outside S. No short full-scope route.

arXiv2307.13684v1 Conjecture 1.1 matches and introductory text says it was proved in reference [6]. Only that report and nearby theorem statements were read; the [6] body is not cleared. No candidate or new credit.

Same source Conjecture 1.2 matches, but Theorem 1.3 additionally excludes generalized t-pyramids. That hypothesis cannot be removed by renaming the graph class. No proof for all bounded-clique even-hole-free graphs established.

Quantifies over arbitrary normal finite-group inclusions, blocks and defects and demands an equivariant bijection preserving character triples. Definitions of chains and triple isomorphism remain source-dependent; known family instances do not provide the all-group construction.

Actual short source body read: W_k is defined and final paragraph reports a joined-matching counterexample. It prints N(v) minus S, while the literal record uses N(v) minus N(S). Exhaustive check of its s=1,t=2 graph fails the literal condition at both universal vertices (alpha=2). Preserve failed bridge; no exact refutation or proof clearance claimed.

For every k>=3 one needs a singular flow plus two rigorous continuations with specified local soliton models. A topological quotient construction alone cannot prove analytic existence/nonuniqueness; substantial geometric PDE chain parked.

The all-alpha,k,l,d embedding-distribution statement needs precise vertex-spread probabilities and threshold normalization. Existence of one Hamilton cycle does not produce a spread distribution; the source's l=0 case cannot settle l>0.

Z and A_k,B_k,C_kl are not defined, and coefficient indexing and degree conventions matter. The record therefore does not enable testing even the first coefficient of the all-primitive stationary formula.

The prose describes only a partition-aligned cover, omitting edge restrictions that distinguish list-cover from an arbitrary multipartite graph. An arbitrary complete bipartite cover would trivially fail and is not a legitimate refutation of the intended logarithmic list-coloring conjecture.

Continuous core, relative bicentralizer and commutant notation require modular-theoretic conventions. The claim covers arbitrary expected inclusions; finite-dimensional examples do not compute general type-III bicentralizers. No short general mechanism.

For all bounded-degree graphs and all k,X,Y one needs either distant paths or an O(k) cut. Ordinary Menger gives disjoint paths with uncontrolled lengths and distances; their bounded-degree neighborhoods may still be unbounded. Greedy deletion is not the needed uniform cut proof.

N_loc must specify height and local-solubility counting convention. Ample orbifold boundary allows exponent 2-deg boundary+epsilon; one needs uniform counting for all standard fibrations, not just one rational example. No full-scope sieve argument supplied.

c_d(G) and normalization of connected-set growth are not defined. Moore order also depends on girth; cycles or disconnected unions under guessed conventions cannot refute the exact strict all-larger-order claim.

For each epsilon a uniform c is required for all regular n-vertex graphs far from every Turan graph. Need source's eventual-n convention before trying a small graph where lambda2<=0. Asymptotic eigenvalue lower bound not established by a finite exception.

Quantifies over all forbidden palette tuples and avoiding colorings with a fixed polynomial homogeneous-subpalette exponent. Ramsey logarithmic bounds do not give this polynomial guarantee. Degenerate one-color conventions would be wording corrections, not a qualifying route.

Source defines Phi as absolute value at a primitive root, absent from the literal formula. Conjecture 4.8 states all maximizers and then says in other words equality, although these differ. At n=k=2 both Schubert polynomials specialize to 1, whereas only 12 is 2-multi-layered. This only defeats the stronger wording; maximum equality and asymptotic remain untouched. No credit.

The two H-star graph families are omitted. The target is eventual exact classification for every edge count above Turan, stronger than a clique-count bound. Refuting the original conjecture does not refute the amended families.

One Client strategy must build a graph simultaneously containing every bounded-degree spanning tree with degree up to cn/log n. Separate strategies for individual trees do not give universality. No all-tree mechanism or finite refutation of eventual n.

Needs fixed positive epsilon and n0 for all near-quarter integer sequences with sum divisible by 3. Finite non-graphic sequences do not defeat an unspecified epsilon,n0. A robust design realization theorem would be substantial; no small full-scope construction found.

The index of a cohomology class and characteristic/invertibility conventions for mu_l need confirmation. Diophantine dimension bounds for all homogeneous forms are global field hypotheses; a single split class or semiglobal analogue does not prove the conjecture.

Requires asymptotic proportions over all free trees and an exponent strictly between 0 and 1. Finite tree enumeration cannot establish Theta power decay. Exact definition of bipartite arrangements is needed even to enumerate faithfully.

All three essential alternatives I-III are suppressed. Convex hull boundaries and symmetry conditions cannot be guessed from powers m_i; no complete N=3 statement has been supplied, let alone its arbitrary-N extension.

Size parameter lambda is not translated into actual family cardinality; degree convention in the induced Kneser graph and implicit identifications of i-slices matter. Symmetric difference of literal disjoint i-slices is not the intended balance comparison without definitions. No rounding counterexample credited.
